# CadQuarry generated-data license notice

Source: <https://github.com/jacobjennings/CadQuarry/blob/543b067ea9e416bc2e9587cb8775e012480b70ee/DATA_LICENSE>

Pinned distribution: <https://huggingface.co/datasets/jacobjennings/cadquarry/commit/be52b95de212431d995c3ebd25bdd9d56a5c96bf>

The upstream `DATA_LICENSE` applies the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal
public-domain dedication to generated CadQuarry data. Its scope explicitly
includes the generated `.py`, `.params.json`, `.meta.json`, `.step`, `.stl`,
`.ply`, and `.png` artifacts in CadQuarry-generated dataset directories. The
generator source code is licensed separately under Apache-2.0.

The pinned Hugging Face distribution also declares `cc0-1.0` for the dataset
and publishes `1k/corpus-step.parquet` as part of the CadQuarry v0.6.0 corpus.

NARU does not redistribute the Parquet corpus. The external-fixture tool pins
the Hugging Face artifact by revision, byte length, and SHA-256 digest and
stores an explicitly fetched copy only in the ignored local cache.

Full CC0 1.0 legal code: <https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode>
